rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Official IPLocate.io MCP server that provides comprehensive IP address intelligence including geolocation, network information, privacy detection, and abuse contacts through the IPLocate.io API. Built with TypeScript and the MCP SDK, it offers six specialized tools for different aspects of IP analysis (location, privacy/security, network/ASN, company data, and abuse contacts) plus four pre-configured prompts for common investigation workflows like security analysis and IP comparison. Designed for cybersecurity professionals, network administrators, and developers who need reliable IP data for threat detection, fraud prevention, compliance monitoring, and general network analysis without requiring direct API integration.
